
  ╭─────────────────────────────────────────────╮
  │  /clear  (/c, /new, /fresh)                 │
  │  Clear Conversation                         │
  ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  Summary:
    Clear the conversation and start fresh.

  Usage:
    /clear
    /new

  Details:
    Clears conversation history, the task tracker, and background
    jobs, and resets rate limiters and budget counters. Learned
    preferences and skills are kept — use /reset for those.

  Examples:
    $ /clear
    $ /new

  Related: /reset
